events: Frozen target contract written before pilot, dataset generation, and baseline scoring.
Six private pilot cases accepted; target contract was not changed.
312 production cases accepted, with eight numerical candidate rejections; all BLAS threads fixed to one and four teacher workers.
Nested outer-sandbox bubblewrap probe failed NETLINK_ROUTE; the same probe succeeded with approved outer escalation.
An initial evaluator invocation raced the queued integrity-seal command and returned evaluator_error; no scoring occurred.

Initial isolated baseline executions exited nonzero before the system alternatives mount was added. Their original traceback was not retained; these were infrastructure failures, not scored model trials.
After adding the read-only system alternatives mount, the unchanged baseline completed public and hidden evaluation successfully.
80 builder scientific and adversarial self-checks passed; no participant agents or adversarial model pool was launched.
